references.label: Bank Shot lane
references.description: The short lane reachable from the upper-right flipper after a weak initial plunge.

references.label: 8-Ball saucer
references.description: The upper-right saucer used to finish Eight Ball, start Ball-O-Rama, collect bonus, and take Call Your Shot.

references.label: Center Pockets assembly
references.description: The three-saucer area behind the rising post used to light and capture locks and start Breakshot Frenzy.

references.label: Super Cue orbits
references.description: The left and right full orbits that sink the next ball when their cue lamps are lit.
